name: Fuobe
description: The open creative studio on ComfyUI: images, video, 3D and audio on open weights, on your own GPU or the cloud. Camera motions, effects, apps, Cinema, Layers, Image to 3D and an AI agent.
readme: The open creative studio on ComfyUI. Images, video, 3D and audio on open weights, on your own GPU or in the cloud. Fuobe is a complete creative studio that you run yourself. Use open-weight models through ComfyUI on your own GPU, or frontier models with your own fal.ai or Replicate key. Every preview clip and still was rendered locally on ComfyUI, on one RTX 5090.
